scope: Local premade template source/config/package JSON and local authored fixtures; excluded assets/evidence/direction studies. No DB/customer scan.

sourceSemantics.anchorsOf: Only authored adv.htmlId is offered by picker.
sourceSemantics.htmlIdControl: Shows autoId as placeholder, so manually copied generated links can exist. Canonical-first preserves old first-match target.

entrypoints.buildPage: One allocation batch across header/page/footer. Server rendering and standalone compileDocument call buildPage.
entrypoints.direct: renderNode and renderList each create fresh local batch when no context is supplied.
entrypoints.preview: paint calls renderPublicLists once across canvas regions.
